title: TYPECAST
description:
"One of the best games of the year! You owe it to yourself to play it." - Noclip

"Typecast offers a truly modernized arcade gameplay experience. It can be played forever, and can genuinely last as long as there is air in your lungs and hatred in your heart." - A Dedicated Fan

"Super simple arcade game that has been polished into the impossible." - Some Guy Who Left A Steam Review

"Please remove me from your mailing list." - A Press Outlet Who Will Remain UnnamedPure Arcade BlissNo meta progression, no roguelike or roguelite elements, no nonsense. Meta progress your own brain as your skills increase and you climb the leaderboards.Ultra Precise MovementYour mouse is your character. Weave in and out of hordes of enemies with perfect precision!Type To ShootEach enemy has a specific letter that you must type in order to destroy them. Be careful, typing the wrong key can have dire consequences!Endless OnslaughtEnemies never stop coming. Fight them off for as long as you can and go for the high score!Deep MechanicsUse slow-mo, bombs, parries, and more to destroy your enemies and climb to the top of the leaderboards!
description_short: TYPECAST is a bullet hell where you type to shoot. Get swarmed by enemies, manage the chaos, and climb the leaderboards in this unique arcade experience.
